terrainDescription.zh: 地勢以平緩珊瑚石灰岩台地為主，僅東北部蘇格蘭區地形較崎嶇（最高點希拉比山僅340公尺），全島人口密度在加勒比地區數一數二高。
terrainDescription.en: Mostly a gently rising coral-limestone plateau, with rougher terrain only in the northeastern Scotland District (the highest point, Mount Hillaby, is just 340m); population density is among the highest in the Caribbean.

historicalContext.zh: 前英國殖民地，靠左行駛，官方語言為英語，日常口語為巴貝多土語（Bajan Creole）；車牌字母代表車主居住的教區，人口較多的教區（如基督堂教區）採雙字母編碼。
historicalContext.en: A former British colony that drives on the left; English is official, with Bajan Creole as the everyday vernacular. License plate letters denote the owner's parish of residence, with more populous parishes (e.g. Christ Church) using double-letter codes.
